rules.title: Prohibition on lessors using algorithmic rent-setting service providers (proposed Ch. 40Z, § 2(a))
rules.requirement: Real estate lessors, and their agents or subcontractors, would be barred from subscribing to, contracting with, or exchanging anything of value for the services of a service provider.
rules.coverage_text: Real estate lessors and their agents or subcontractors; the excerpt does not define 'service provider' or limit coverage by unit count or building age.
rules.quoted_span: No real estate lessor, or any agent or subcontractor thereof, shall subscribe to, contract with or otherwise exchange anything of value in return for the services of a service provider.
rules.ambiguity_note: Bill is pending (reported favorably 3/12/2026 and referred to House Ways and Means). The excerpt does not define 'service provider'.

rules.title: Prohibition on service providers facilitating agreements not to compete (proposed Ch. 40Z, § 2(b))
rules.requirement: A service provider would be barred from facilitating an agreement among real estate lessors to not compete with respect to residential dwelling units.
rules.coverage_text: Service providers facilitating non-competition agreements among lessors of residential dwelling units.
rules.quoted_span: No service provider shall facilitate an agreement to not compete among real estate lessors with respect to residential dwelling units.
rules.ambiguity_note: Bill is pending; it has been referred to House Ways and Means.
